name: GitHub OAuth MCP Server
description: A remote MCP server for Cloudflare Workers featuring built-in GitHub OAuth for secure user authentication and identity-based access control to tools. It provides a reference implementation for managing remote MCP connections with persistent state and OAuth provider integration.
